accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.onboardingBody: Smart Route uses the subscriptions you already have. Connect each account once: the command-line account lets the app run models for you, the web workspace lets you hand tasks over to the vendor’s own site.
accounts.privacy: Sign-in happens only in the vendor’s own tool or page. Smart Route never sees or stores a password or a token.

settings.about.title: About
about.name: Thierry MEMEL
about.title: AI/ML and energy systems researcher · Mentor · Founder of Yolea
about.text: Thierry MEMEL is a researcher in artificial intelligence, machine learning and energy systems, a mentor, and the founder of Yolea, a human-centred AI and education company based in Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire. Author of The AI Tamer series, he explains technology in plain words and concrete examples, so that everyone can learn to use AI responsibly and make their own life easier.
about.why: Smart Route started as a gesture repeated every day at Yolea: choosing by hand, among several AI assistants, the one that fits the task.
about.support: Smart Route is free and open. If you want to help us build what comes next, the “Support Smart Route” page says how.
web.signinBlocked.title: Google sign-in isn't possible here
web.signinBlocked.body: Google doesn’t allow sign-in inside a window embedded in an app. Sign in with your e-mail address (a code is sent to you), or open the site in your usual browser.
web.signinBlocked.body.google: Google doesn’t allow sign-in inside a window embedded in an app. Open Gemini in your usual browser, where you are already signed in.
